--- a/openlibrary/tests/core/lists/test_model.py
+++ b/openlibrary/tests/core/lists/test_model.py
@@ -3,6 +3,46 @@ import openlibrary.core.lists.model as list_model
 
 
 class TestList:
+    def test_mixed_seed_representations(self):
+        list_model.register_models()
+        site = MockSite()
+        self.save_doc(site, '/type/edition', '/books/OL1M', title='One')
+        self.save_doc(site, '/type/list', '/lists/OL1L', name='Test', seeds=[])
+        lst = site.get('/lists/OL1L')
+        edition = site.get('/books/OL1M')
+
+        assert lst.add_seed(edition)
+        assert not lst.add_seed({'key': edition.key})
+        assert lst.has_seed(edition.key)
+        assert lst.remove_seed({'key': edition.key})
+        assert lst.add_seed({'key': edition.key})
+        assert lst.add_seed('subject:history')
+        seeds = lst.get_seeds()
+        assert [seed.key for seed in seeds] == [edition.key, 'subject:history']
+        assert seeds[0].document.key == edition.key
+        assert lst.remove_seed('subject:history')
+
+    def test_export_list_filters_loaded_types(self):
+        list_model.register_models()
+        site = MockSite()
+        self.save_doc(site, '/type/edition', '/books/OL1M', title='One')
+        self.save_doc(site, '/type/work', '/works/OL2W', title='Two')
+        self.save_doc(site, '/type/author', '/authors/OL3A', name='Three')
+        self.save_doc(site, '/type/list', '/lists/OL1L', name='Test', seeds=[])
+        lst = site.get('/lists/OL1L')
+        lst.seeds = [
+            {'key': '/books/OL1M'},
+            site.get('/works/OL2W'),
+            {'key': '/authors/OL3A'},
+            {'key': '/books/missing'},
+            'subject:history',
+        ]
+        exported = lst.get_export_list()
+        assert set(exported) == {'authors', 'works', 'editions'}
+        assert [d['key'] for d in exported['authors']] == ['/authors/OL3A']
+        assert [d['key'] for d in exported['works']] == ['/works/OL2W']
+        assert [d['key'] for d in exported['editions']] == ['/books/OL1M']

from openlibrary.mocks.mock_infobase import MockSite
import openlibrary.core.lists.model as list_model


class TestList:
    def test_mixed_seed_representations(self):
        list_model.register_models()
        site = MockSite()
        self.save_doc(site, '/type/edition', '/books/OL1M', title='One')
        self.save_doc(site, '/type/list', '/lists/OL1L', name='Test', seeds=[])
        lst = site.get('/lists/OL1L')
        edition = site.get('/books/OL1M')

        assert lst.add_seed(edition)
        assert not lst.add_seed({'key': edition.key})
        assert lst.has_seed(edition.key)
        assert lst.remove_seed({'key': edition.key})
        assert lst.add_seed({'key': edition.key})
        assert lst.add_seed('subject:history')
        seeds = lst.get_seeds()
        assert [seed.key for seed in seeds] == [edition.key, 'subject:history']
        assert seeds[0].document.key == edition.key
        assert lst.remove_seed('subject:history')

    def test_export_list_filters_loaded_types(self):
        list_model.register_models()
        site = MockSite()
        self.save_doc(site, '/type/edition', '/books/OL1M', title='One')
        self.save_doc(site, '/type/work', '/works/OL2W', title='Two')
        self.save_doc(site, '/type/author', '/authors/OL3A', name='Three')
        self.save_doc(site, '/type/list', '/lists/OL1L', name='Test', seeds=[])
        lst = site.get('/lists/OL1L')
        lst.seeds = [
            {'key': '/books/OL1M'},
            site.get('/works/OL2W'),
            {'key': '/authors/OL3A'},
            {'key': '/books/missing'},
            'subject:history',
        ]
        exported = lst.get_export_list()
        assert set(exported) == {'authors', 'works', 'editions'}
        assert [d['key'] for d in exported['authors']] == ['/authors/OL3A']
        assert [d['key'] for d in exported['works']] == ['/works/OL2W']
        assert [d['key'] for d in exported['editions']] == ['/books/OL1M']

    def test_owner(self):
        list_model.register_models()
        self._test_list_owner("/people/anand")
        self._test_list_owner("/people/anand-test")
        self._test_list_owner("/people/anand_test")

    def _test_list_owner(self, user_key):
        site = MockSite()
        list_key = user_key + "/lists/OL1L"

        self.save_doc(site, "/type/user", user_key)
        self.save_doc(site, "/type/list", list_key)

        list = site.get(list_key)
        assert list is not None
        assert isinstance(list, list_model.List)

        assert list.get_owner() is not None
        assert list.get_owner().key == user_key

    def save_doc(self, site, type, key, **fields):
        d = {"key": key, "type": {"key": type}}
        d.update(fields)
        site.save(d)

from openlibrary.plugins.openlibrary import lists
from openlibrary.plugins.openlibrary.lists import ListRecord


def test_process_seeds():
    process_seeds = lists.lists_json().process_seeds

    def f(s):
        return process_seeds([s])[0]

    assert f("/books/OL1M") == {"key": "/books/OL1M"}
    assert f({"key": "/books/OL1M"}) == {"key": "/books/OL1M"}
    assert f("/subjects/love") == "subject:love"
    assert f("subject:love") == "subject:love"


def test_subject_seed_normalization():
    assert lists.subject_key_to_seed('/subjects/place:New__York,USA') == 'place:New_York_USA'
    assert lists.subject_key_to_seed('/subjects/Politics__and,government') == 'subject:Politics_and_government'
    assert lists.is_seed_subject_string('time:modern')
    assert not lists.is_seed_subject_string('placebo:modern')
    assert ListRecord.normalize_input_seed({'key': '/subjects/love'}) == 'subject:love'

    can use the solr API to fetch list works and render them in
    carousels in the right format.

VERDICT: FIX

[List.get_book_keys()](/app/openlibrary/core/lists/model.py:153) resolves every seed’s document before filtering for books. A subject lookup failure can therefore stop list search even when the list contains a valid edition. In a local reproduction with one subject and one edition, a mocked subject lookup raised `RuntimeError: subject lookup unavailable`. Filter seed keys before resolving documents, so book key collection does not fetch subject metadata.
